data.title: Lawns and landscapes the neighbors notice
data.subtitle: Recurring weekly mowing, full landscape installations, and snow management across the Driftless region. Same crew every visit, same standard whether you're a $35 weekly mow or a $35,000 install.

data.heading: What we do — every season
data.intro: Weekly mowing is most of what we do, but we earn the relationship by handling the spring cleanup, the summer install, the fall leaves, and the 6am driveway plow without anyone needing to ask.

items.title: Lawn care
items.description: Weekly mowing with sharp blades on zero-turns — your lawn reads cleaner than what the national chains leave behind. Fertilization, aeration, overseeding, and weed control on quarterly visits.
bullets: Same crew every visit when possible

items.title: Landscape design + install
items.description: From a 12-foot bed refresh to a full backyard redesign with hardscape, plantings, and lighting. We design in-house and install with our own crew — no subs.

Native-plant-forward palettes that thrive in this climate

items.title: Spring + fall cleanups
items.description: Beds opened in spring, leaves and beds put to bed in fall. The kind of seasonal work that turns a one-time customer into a recurring client when we show up before they have to call.

items.title: Snow & ice management
items.description: Residential and commercial. Driveways, walks, and parking lots. We start when the snow does, not when it stops.
